en: Colorized photographic postcard showing a formation of German soldiers in dark green uniforms with red piping, boots, and rifles on their shoulders, marching on a dirt path in a park-like or training-ground setting. The men wear pickelhaube-style caps with plumes. At the top in German text it identifies the location as Freiberg and the unit as the K.S. 1. Jäger-Bataillon Nr. 12.
